state_law: OBSERVED != INFERRED != PROPOSED != ATTEMPTED != EXECUTED != VERIFIED != COMMITTED != DEPLOYED != OBSERVED_IN_OPERATION; receipts control claims about state changes, not permission to continue unrelated work

execution_law.routine_reversible: execute exact mission-authorized route, verify, persist receipt
execution_law.local_block: record continuation and reroute/continue elsewhere; never globalize automatically
execution_law.checkpoint: observability/resume surface, never a generic permission gate

failure_escalation_law: auth_failure -> isolate dependent route + stale freshness + reauth/probe; unaffected routes continue
rate_limit -> respect cooldown + no retry storms + record budget impact; alternate valid routes continue
ambiguous_external_outcome -> never auto-replay; reconcile provider evidence before retrying that side effect
source_or_schema_integrity_failure -> block only the affected claim/route until repaired
projection_failure_after_durable_success -> recover from durable payload; never reinvoke connector merely to satisfy projection
no policy failure may manufacture a generalized approval gate or global stop-work condition
